description: Add a page of its own to a portal: a name and the page's content as HTML. It goes into the portal's menu under its name by itself — do not call add_portal_menu_item for it. For a page that shows the project's forms or tables use generate_ai_site instead.

add_to_menu.description: false = create it without a menu item (default true)

html.description: The page's content: headings, paragraphs, lists (or a whole HTML document)

portal_id.description: From list_portals; may be left out when the project has one portal

name: create_portal_page
